custom_description_lines: Classification monitoring for the inventory behind the IFBI governance dashboard.
ACTIVATION is the first monitor summary, not a security incident. NEW, REMINDER and RECOVERY are classification-change events. SUMMARY is aggregate coverage backlog.
The total includes the selected batch; up to 99 owner/table/finding groups and example columns are shown. The monitor notification view contains the full detail.
No customer values are included. Scheduled automation uses the collector -> native SQL alert -> evaluation receipt job. A successful evaluation does not attest mailbox delivery.
